name: contextflo
description: Contextflo connects your data sources (Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MySQL, ClickHouse, Databricks) to Claude with a managed context layer, access controls, and query visibility. Your team asks questions in natural language, Contextflo provides the business context and governance so the answers are accurate and consistent. No MCP config or YAML to maintain.

_published_faq.name: How do I add contextflo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add contextflo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.contextflo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the contextflo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: contextflo lists 28 MCP tools, including call-endpoint, create-business-concept, create-dashboard, create-metric, create-report, execute-query, export-excel, find-related-resources, generate-temp-token, get-business-concept, get-dashboard, and get-dashboard-schema.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to contextflo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to contextflo in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
contextflo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
contextflo is developed by Contextflo, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
